summary: R-6 flat-roof ground cab on Bald Mountain ridge, Jackson County, OR; register and two sites date it 1956, a 1957 newspaper says finished that autumn; staffed in summer.

access.note: Staffed in summer. Reached by a gated forest road and a walk of about 0.3 mile. Inferred from a 2023 visit account; no Forest Service access rule was found.

visit.trail_note: Turn west from Highway 62 onto Road 64, take Road 200 at the fork 2.8 miles along, drive 5.6 miles to the gate, then walk about 0.3 mile up the road. Gate hours are not given in the sources.

events.note: Tree crow's nest platform on the site, per firelookout.com (year given as 'about 1912')
L-4 structure in the 1930s; exact year not given. firelookout.com calls it a tower, cherylhill.net a cabin
Build year per the register, firelookout.com and cherylhill.net. The 1957 newspaper reports below conflict with it
Newspaper items quoted on the Oregon Lookouts page: a new lookout to be built soon (August 1957); the flat-top structure recently finished (October 1957)
Newspaper item quoted on the Oregon Lookouts page: a couple stationed at the lookout for the summer
Registered March 31, 2003 as NHLR US 491, OR 84
Visit account dated 2023-08-22 lists the status as Staffed

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register, firelookout.com and cherylhill.net give 1956. A 1957 newspaper item quoted on the Oregon Lookouts page says the new structure was finished that autumn. The story gives both and does not settle the date.
firelookout.com calls the 1930s L-4 a tower; cherylhill.net calls it a cabin. The story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Build year conflict: 1956 (register, firelookout.com, cherylhill.net) vs a 1957 completion in newspaper items quoted on the Oregon Lookouts page. Elevation: the register gives 4,470 ft (1,362 m), matching the record's 1362.5 m; cherylhill.net gives 5,006 ft, not used. Access 'public' is inferred from a 2023 visit account, not a Forest Service rule; check before publishing. Whetstone burned (register) vs removed (cherylhill.net) in 1958 concerns a different site. No fire history found; no WebSearch used. Visitor names in source pages are left out on purpose.
